title: React motion studio
summary: Build scoped, sequenced React animations with lifecycle cleanup.

stages.title: Establish animation primitives
stages.task: Choose targets and tweens; document reduced-motion alternatives.

stages.title: Compose the sequence
stages.task: Create named labels and intentional timing from the approved motion brief.

stages.title: Integrate and verify cleanup
stages.task: Use scoped refs and useGSAP; check rerenders, unmount and reduced motion.

requirements: React, gsap and @gsap/react. Runtime library terms are separate from skill MIT licenses.
conflicts: Core examples do not override React lifecycle guidance. Use gsap-react cleanup in React. ScrollTrigger and other plugins are outside this pack.
compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex runtime test.

title: Industrial interface + motion
summary: Apply a deliberate monochrome identity, then add restrained interaction.

stages.title: Set the visual system
stages.task: Apply Nothing-inspired styling only when explicitly requested; record tokens and readable contrast.

stages.title: Add functional motion
stages.task: Animate only interactions justified by the brief; preserve reduced-motion behavior.

requirements: A web project and GSAP runtime. Optional external fonts need separate setup.
conflicts: Keep nothing-design as the visual owner; GSAP only owns animation. Codex compatibility of nothing-design is unknown. Do not let motion change the typography or layout.
compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex runtime test.

title: Article to presentation
summary: Create an editorial web article and adapt its evidence into a presentation.

stages.title: Produce the source article
stages.task: Write the approved article with traceable claims and export a stable content outline.

stages.title: Adapt to presentation scenes
stages.task: Use that outline as input; review story, scene outline and rendered presentation at separate checkpoints.

requirements: Vite, React and TypeScript for generated projects. Optional TTS requires separate services; source skills are Chinese.
conflicts: Pass an article/outline between stages, not conflicting project scaffolds. Use separate output directories. Adapt upstream agent/reviewer instructions to your host; do not assume subagents or voice services exist.
compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex runtime test.

title: Evidence to editorial report
summary: Evaluate provided evidence before turning it into a readable web report.

stages.title: Appraise supplied evidence
stages.task: Create a source/claim/limitation table from user-provided papers; core appraisal only, no optional schematic service.

stages.title: Publish the bounded conclusions
stages.task: Use the approved evidence table to build an editorial article; keep uncertainty, references and missing evidence visible.

requirements: User-provided sources; frontend tooling for article output. No database retrieval, paid figures or TTS is included.
conflicts: Critical-thinking owns claim strength; article design must not inflate certainty. Optional sibling skills are excluded. This is not a clinical recommendation workflow.
compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex runtime test.

title: React architecture review
summary: Plan composable components, then review rendering performance.

stages.title: Define component boundaries
stages.task: Replace boolean-heavy APIs using compound components and explicit state ownership.

stages.title: Audit performance
stages.task: Review the resulting components for rendering and loading problems; retain approved public APIs.

requirements: React project. Install each skill using its pinned setup instructions.
conflicts: Architecture owns the component contract; performance changes must preserve it. Recipe only: complete redistributable license evidence for every member is not yet captured.
compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex runtime test.

title: Scholarly research pipeline
summary: Plan a search, gather evidence, then critically appraise the findings.

stages.title: Define the review protocol
stages.task: Define databases, date range, inclusion/exclusion and screening log before searching.

stages.title: Collect a bounded evidence packet
stages.task: Collect source excerpts with explicit provider consent; do not confuse retrieval with claim verification.

stages.title: Appraise claims
stages.task: Evaluate the included full texts and document bias, uncertainties and applicability.

requirements: Upstream installation, Python 3.10+, network and Parallel authentication; optional OpenRouter/PDF tooling.
conflicts: Literature-review owns the protocol. Research-lookup is a retrieval assistant, not a systematic-review engine. No claim of exhaustive coverage. Recipe only because service and sibling dependencies need upstream setup.
compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex runtime test.

title: Context onboarding path
summary: Learn context mechanics, then name the active failure pattern.

stages.title: State the principles
stages.task: Write an attention-budget checklist: edges versus middle, and the progressive-disclosure rule. No operational diagnosis.

stages.title: Name the failure
stages.task: Consume the checklist and write a diagnosis note: pattern name and a Write, Select, Compress, or Isolate bucket.

requirements: Agent Skills host. An optional tokenizer is not required. No credentials are claimed by either skill folder. Static-reviewed only. No end-to-end runtime test. Recipe only this cycle; no ZIP and no license blob pin.
conflicts: Fundamentals owns framing; degradation owns diagnosis. Do not start optimization, compression, or filesystem offload until the diagnosis note names a bucket. Resolver: degradation, after fundamentals.
compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex runtime test.

title: Context diagnose-and-offload
summary: Diagnose a crowded window, then store bulky state as file references.

stages.title: Choose the Write bucket
stages.task: Diagnose the failure and list bulky tool dumps, logs, and plans with agreed project-relative paths.

stages.title: Offload and reference
stages.task: Store those items and return file references plus compact summaries, not re-inlined dumps.

requirements: Host file read, write, and search. Review write paths before use. No network credentials are claimed. Static-reviewed only. No end-to-end runtime test. Recipe only this cycle; no ZIP and no license blob pin.
conflicts: Degradation owns whether Write is correct; filesystem-context owns how to store and retrieve. If the note names Compress or Select, stop and use context-diagnose-compress or context-optimization. Resolver: degradation.
compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex runtime test.

title: Context diagnose-and-compress
summary: Diagnose a shrinkable window, then write a structured handoff summary.

stages.title: Choose the Compress bucket
stages.task: Name the pattern and list what must survive: files, decisions, errors, and next steps.

stages.title: Write the structured summary
stages.task: Produce Session Intent, Files Modified, Decisions, Current State, and Next Steps from that checklist.

requirements: context-compression is already catalogued. Its optional compression_evaluator.py is not part of this recipe and was not run. Static-reviewed only. No end-to-end runtime test. Recipe only this cycle; no ZIP and no license blob pin.
conflicts: Degradation chooses the bucket; compression owns summary structure. Do not substitute filesystem-context when the need is summary wording. Resolver: degradation chooses; compression owns the text.
compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex runtime test.

title: Superpowers evidence-then-TDD
summary: Establish a root cause, then implement the fix under iron-law TDD.

stages.title: Investigate without fixing
stages.task: Complete root-cause, pattern, and hypothesis work and record the smallest reproduction. No production fix yet.

stages.title: Fail, then implement
stages.task: Write a failing test from that reproduction, watch it fail, then make the project suite green.

requirements: The user's project test runner. Optional Superpowers plugin telemetry can be disabled with SUPERPOWERS_DISABLE_TELEMETRY. Stays a recipe because systematic-debugging is not installable. Static-reviewed only. No end-to-end runtime test. Recipe only this cycle; no ZIP and no license blob pin.
conflicts: Debugging owns root cause; test-driven-development owns red-green-refactor. Do not also load mattpocock tdd or diagnosing-bugs. Resolver: debugging until the root cause is written, then TDD.
compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex runtime test.

title: Hard-bug loop then TDD
summary: Build a red feedback loop, then lock the fix with one vertical TDD slice.

stages.title: Build the red loop
stages.task: Produce a named red-capable command with redacted output, a minimised reproduction, and a seam proposal.

stages.title: Test the confirmed seam
stages.task: After the user confirms the seam, write one failing test and the smallest green implementation.

requirements: The user's own tests, curl, CLI, or Playwright as chosen in phase 1. scripts/hitl-loop.template.sh is optional, not packaged, and was not executed. Static-reviewed only. No end-to-end runtime test. Recipe only this cycle; no ZIP and no license blob pin.
conflicts: diagnosing-bugs owns the loop and hypotheses; tdd owns seams and anti-patterns. Do not combine with systematic-debugging or obra test-driven-development. If no correct seam exists, stop. Resolver: diagnosing-bugs through phase 4, then tdd.
compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex runtime test.

title: Artifact-backed session travel
summary: Persist bulky session state, then write a portable handoff that references it.

stages.title: Persist durable artifacts
stages.task: Store plans, scratch outputs, and workspaces under agreed project paths and record a cleanup policy.

stages.title: Write the travel document
stages.task: Save an OS-temp handoff that references those paths, redacts secrets, and lists suggested skills.

requirements: Writable OS temp and the project filesystem. Deferred compaction-handoff is not a dependency. Static-reviewed only. No end-to-end runtime test. Recipe only this cycle; no ZIP and no license blob pin.
conflicts: filesystem-context owns storage layout; handoff owns the travel document and redaction. Prefer in-session compact when nothing must travel. Resolver: the user chooses travel versus stay; handoff owns the temp file.
compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex runtime test.

title: Session boundary then travel
summary: Close a task with a restart checklist, then emit a portable handoff.

stages.title: Complete the boundary checklist
stages.task: Record scope, decisions, task status, files changed, verification commands, and risks before leaving the session.

stages.title: Write the travel document
stages.task: Save an OS-temp handoff that points at those durable artifacts and names suggested skills.

requirements: A project rules file such as AGENTS.md is encouraged. Optional MCP servers named by context-engineering are not required. Static-reviewed only. No end-to-end runtime test. Recipe only this cycle; no ZIP and no license blob pin.
conflicts: context-engineering owns the leave-session checklist; handoff owns the portable file. This is not a substitute for context-diagnose-compress. Resolver: context-engineering at the boundary; handoff when travel is required.
compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex runtime test.

title: Colleague-ready handoff
summary: Write a portable handoff, then rewrite the prose for a human colleague.

stages.title: Draft the handoff
stages.task: Save a redacted OS-temp handoff that references paths instead of duplicating specs.

stages.title: Rewrite for a colleague
stages.task: Remove AI writing tells without changing claims, commands, paths, or fenced code.

requirements: OS temp and the ability to edit the handoff file. No network or credentials. Skip humanizer when the audience is another agent. Static-reviewed only. No end-to-end runtime test. Recipe only this cycle; no ZIP and no license blob pin.
conflicts: handoff owns structure, suggested skills, and redaction; humanizer owns prose style only and must not invent facts. Resolver: handoff first; humanizer only for a human-facing audience.
compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex runtime test.

title: Validated learning to PRD
summary: Turn a persevere decision into an engineering-ready PRD.

stages.title: Record validated learning
stages.task: Name the riskiest assumptions, the MVP and what was measured, actionable metrics, and an explicit persevere or scoped pivot. Do not write the PRD here.

stages.title: Write the PRD
stages.task: Consume that validated-learning memo as the problem summary and success metrics, then write the stakeholder PRD.

requirements: Agent Skills host. Neither skill folder requires a paid API. Optional .claude/pm-skills.local.md may hold initiative context; review before sharing. Static-reviewed only. No end-to-end runtime test. Recipe only this cycle; no ZIP and no license blob pin.
conflicts: lean-startup owns experiment design and whether evidence justifies building. deliver-prd owns specification structure. Do not start the PRD while the problem is still unvalidated, and do not load both at once. Do not let smallest-MVP language erase agreed scope once the memo says persevere. Resolver: lean-startup until the memo records persevere or a scoped post-pivot baseline, then deliver-prd.
compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex runtime test.

title: PRD to TDD implementation
summary: Lock PRD behaviour with one vertical-slice red-green loop.

stages.title: Finish testable requirements
stages.task: Write numbered, testable functional requirements and, when a cold executor needs it, the verification contract.

stages.title: Fail, then implement
stages.task: After a seam is confirmed, write one failing test from a numbered requirement, watch it fail, then make the smallest green change.

requirements: The project test runner and the catalogued tdd install. deliver-prd is Apache-2.0 and tdd is MIT; any future pack must carry both notices. Do not also load obra test-driven-development or diagnosing-bugs. Static-reviewed only. No end-to-end runtime test. Recipe only this cycle; no ZIP and no license blob pin.
conflicts: deliver-prd owns what must be true. tdd owns the red-green seam and test anti-patterns. If no correct seam exists, stop rather than force a weak test. Resolver: deliver-prd until requirements are testable, then tdd. This recipe uses only catalogued mattpocock tdd.
compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex runtime test.

title: Clarity then humanize
summary: Keep the facts stable, then remove AI writing tells.

stages.title: Check clarity and fidelity
stages.task: Organize the explanation, status, comparison, or doc and pass the delivery checklist for certainty, numbers, exceptions, and paths.

stages.title: Remove AI writing tells
stages.task: Rewrite that clarity-checked draft. Keep every supported claim, and preserve code, paths, commands, and YAML.

requirements: Ability to edit the draft. No network or credentials are claimed for either core skill. A voice sample for humanizer is optional. COMPASS personal-OS siblings are not part of this recipe. Static-reviewed only. No end-to-end runtime test. Recipe only this cycle; no ZIP and no license blob pin.
conflicts: clear-communication owns selection, structure, and fidelity. humanizer owns style only and must not invent facts or change commands, paths, or requirements. Do not run both as simultaneous rewrite directors, and do not pair clear-communication with beautiful-article as co-authors. Skip humanizer when the audience is another agent. Resolver: clear-communication first; humanizer only for human-facing output.
compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex runtime test.

title: PRD session travel
summary: Reference an approved PRD from a portable session handoff.

stages.title: Store the PRD
stages.task: Write the durable PRD at an agreed repository or docs path, including open questions and owners.

stages.title: Write the travel document
stages.task: Save an OS-temp handoff that points at that path, redacts secrets, and names next skills such as tdd. Do not paste the full PRD.

requirements: Writable OS temp and a project path for the PRD. Catalogued handoff. Optional pm-skills local memory is not required. No App Store or network credentials. Static-reviewed only. No end-to-end runtime test. Recipe only this cycle; no ZIP and no license blob pin.
conflicts: deliver-prd owns product requirements. handoff owns travel packaging and redaction. Use prd-to-tdd when staying to implement. Prefer in-session work when nothing travels. Resolver: the user chooses travel versus implement-in-place; handoff owns the temp file when travel is required.
compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex runtime test.

title: Evidence-led coding loop
summary: Write a behavior test, evaluate review feedback, then verify the actual result.

stages.title: Define a failing behavior
stages.task: Use a scoped failing test and a minimal change; preserve existing work and follow the project test policy.

stages.title: Evaluate review feedback
stages.task: Check each suggestion against repository behavior before changing code; keep justified decisions and evidence.

stages.title: Verify completion
stages.task: Run the commands that demonstrate the requested outcome and report failures and unrun checks.

requirements: Reviewed upstream Superpowers setup and an existing project test toolchain. Recipe only: no full plugin, hooks or test runner are bundled.
conflicts: User and project decisions override upstream rewrite/delete or always-test mandates. Review must not silently change the approved scope. A passing test alone does not prove a deployment or a UI flow works.
compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex or Claude Code runtime test.

title: Durable context and handoff
summary: Keep raw evidence in files, summarize the active task, then retain only useful cross-session knowledge.

stages.title: Offload bulky evidence
stages.task: Save raw outputs with paths and source timestamps; reload narrow excerpts rather than entire logs.

stages.title: Write a recoverable handoff
stages.task: Record goals, decisions, changed files, verification and next actions while preserving links to raw evidence.

stages.title: Retain durable knowledge
stages.task: Persist only knowledge that must survive sessions, with provenance and a retention policy; start with files.

requirements: Filesystem access and reviewed individual skills. Optional memory implementations have separate dependencies. Recipe only; the preserved compression pin is older than the new context guides.
conflicts: Scratch files are not semantic memory. Offloading does not evict old chat messages or guarantee lower billing. Do not load every memory file by default; measure accuracy, latency and tokens on the same tasks.
compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex or Claude Code runtime test.

title: Expo design to native review
summary: Confirm Expo/SDK context, unify design tokens, then review native screen behavior and performance.

stages.title: Route the task and detect SDK
stages.task: Inspect package.json and the requested goal; route only Expo projects through this workflow.

stages.title: Adopt a visual system
stages.task: Reuse the declared theme/library and define screen/component conventions without a second competing system.

stages.title: Review native screen behavior
stages.task: Check platform controls, safe areas, keyboard access, dynamic text and data failure/recovery states.

stages.title: Audit measured hotspots
stages.task: Review list rendering and animation hotspots without overriding the approved design or choosing unsupported packages.

requirements: Upstream Expo plugin and its routed siblings, a version-matched Expo project and platform simulator/device access for a real trial. Vercel guidance has unknown Codex/Claude support in the inspected README. Recipe only.
conflicts: Expo guidance owns SDK and native platform decisions; performance advice cannot override accessibility or theme decisions. SwiftUI Expert is an alternative for a native Apple project, not another design layer to load into an Expo app. No API versions or device outcomes were validated here.
compatibility: Static workflow proposal; no end-to-end Codex or Claude Code runtime test.
